convert_nougat_checkpoint: convert a Nougat checkpoint to HuggingFace format using the original nougat library
run_convert_nougat_cli: run the Nougat-to-HuggingFace conversion script via CLI with model tag and output path
get_nougat_configs: get encoder and decoder HuggingFace configs from a Nougat model for conversion
rename_nougat_keys: rename Nougat state dict keys to match HuggingFace DonutSwin and MBart naming conventions
convert_nougat_state_dict: convert a Nougat state dict to HuggingFace format by splitting QKV weights and renaming keys
